title: The B2B Redesign Rule
facebook_comment_text: An outdated platform isn't just about looks; it's an engineering bottleneck. It often means siloed data, poor CRM integration, and a lack of scalability needed for bespoke B2B solutions. This directly impacts premium client onboarding & trust. 🤔 What essential integration or feature has your current platform struggled to deliver for your top-tier clients?
